answers.core:
Yes, this should be core functionality because:
- It's a fundamental debugging workflow improvement
- It requires deep integration with the debugger's internal systems
- It enhances the built-in debugging tools that all developers use
- Similar functionality is standard in most modern IDEs and debugging tools

This enhancement would significantly improve the debugging experience and align Godot's tools with industry standards for development environments.
answers.workaround:
This cannot be easily worked around with scripting as it requires:
- Direct access to the debugger's internal stack trace data
- Integration with the IDE's clipboard functionality
- Modification of the built-in debugger UI components

The feature would be used frequently by developers who:
- Work in teams and need to share debugging information
- Document complex call stacks for bug reports
- Integrate Godot debugging with external tools or documentation systems
